info.name: PrivateID Edge — Regression
info.description:
Regression suite for the PrivateID edge component. GENERATED from src/selftest/ by scripts/generate-postman-collection.js — regenerate with `npm run qa:postman`, do not hand-edit folders 00–05.

Order of use: 00 Preflight → 01 store-safe contract → 02 (UAT) → 04 temp journey (UAT) → 05 self-test. 03 writes; non-production only.

Run every folder twice: forwardToCloud=false (store offline) and forwardToCloud=true (online). qa/run-regression.sh does both.

exec: // Values that depend on the time of the run. Frozen into the file they would expire.

item.name: 00 Preflight — what is this store actually running
item.description: Run first, every time. Read-only, safe at a live store. config-status is the one that matters: remote config overrides .env at runtime and wins silently, so the flags in a file are not necessarily what the store is running. Check `source`, `store.edgeVersion` and `circuitBreaker.enabled` before trusting any later result.

request.description: Effective flags and where they came from (attributes service, disk cache, or .env fallback).

exec: console.log("config source:", b.source, "edgeVersion:", b.store && b.store.edgeVersion, "breaker:", b.circuitBreaker && b.circuitBreaker.enabled);
pm.test("config source is reported", function () { pm.expect(b.source).to.exist; });

request.description: Must match the build under test.
Edge-local liveness.
Exempt from the API key guard, so it must answer with no key. Status is normalised fail-closed.
Enforcement mode (warn/strict) and an inventory of keys seen per endpoint.

item.name: 04 Journey — temp employee end to end (WRITES, UAT/non-prod)
item.description: One fresh temp employee per run, walked through the lifecycle a store actually performs: register → local credential auth → face enrolment on both models → 1:1 and 1:N match on each → cross-model negative → barcode register → barcode auth → roster → lookup → the SOS UI's keyless fallback (verify-credentials, generate-barcode, verify-barcode). Needs no IDP and no real associate. Run the whole folder in order; it stops at the first failed prerequisite. Run once with forwardToCloud=false (store offline) and once with true (online).

request.description:
Liveness before anything else. If this is not answering, every later failure is noise.

Source of truth: `src/selftest/journey.js` step `health-idp (before, temp)`.

item.name: 99 Templates — add your own test cases here
item.description:
Duplicate a request into this folder (or a new folder of your own) to add a case. The variables in the environment carry the store, key and test identities; the collection pre-request sets profileExpiryTime and expireAt.

To make a case part of the contract policy, put it in a folder with the same test script as folder 01 (Folder → Scripts → Post-response), or copy the script into the request.

Regenerating (`npm run qa:postman`) rewrites the whole file, so keep your own cases in a separate collection (or a fork of this one) and pull new releases of this file alongside it. A case that should run everywhere — CI gate, self-test API, CLI and this collection — is better added as a row in src/selftest/endpoints.js or a step in journey.js; send it to the PrivateID team and it arrives in the next regeneration.
